response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in production routing or geospatial data pipelines, and his recent work is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js — raising concerns about his current proficiency in the required systems programming stack.
strengths: Built and maintained open-source geospatial platform (GISCollective) with real-world usage
Demonstrated deep systems-level experience with DLang, asynchronous I/O, and low-latency systems
Strong track record of learning new technologies and contributing across diverse technical stacks
concerns: No explicit C++ or Rust experience in commercial routing, navigation, or geospatial data pipelines
Recent roles focus on TypeScript/Node.js, not the core C++ required for this role
Limited evidence of distributed systems or fault-tolerant data pipeline design at scale
